newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends sharply lower vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends sharply lower vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended at a historic low against the dollar of 1,092.50 after falling under pressure from a surge in demand for U.S. currency from the corporate sector, interbank dealers said.
They said telephone companies and the automotive and metallurgical sectors were among those who demanded greenbacks throughout the volatile trading session.

There was some speculation that the exchange rate had been driven up artificially, since that would allow banks and businesses to write off larger-than-expected foreign losses at the end of the month.
But dollar demand had been expected to pick up following a government announcement that it was eliminating the temporary hike in import tariffs it announced in March.
Dealers reported 357 trades for a total of $176 million and said the peso, which dropped three pesos from Wednesday's close, ended Thursday's hectic session at its intraday and all-time low.
